note: Public information as of 14 Nov 2026. Dates are targets set by each agency or company and often slip. Each entry links its source.

missions.name: Artemis IV
missions.goal: First crewed landing since 1972. Two astronauts spend about a week near the south pole.

missions.name: Chang'e-7
missions.goal: Orbiter, lander, rover and a hopper that searches for water ice in shadowed craters.
missions.target: Near the rim of Shackleton crater
missions.short: Lander, rover and hopper. 2027, near Shackleton crater.

missions.name: Chandrayaan-4
missions.short: Sample return. Around 2027 to 2028, near Mons Mouton studied.
missions.goal: First Indian lunar sample return, from the south polar region.
missions.target: South polar region; a site near Mons Mouton is under study

missions.name: Chang'e-8
missions.goal: Tests using lunar soil, including 3D-printed bricks.
missions.short: Tests with lunar soil. 2028, near Mons Mouton.

missions.name: Chandrayaan-5 / LUPEX
missions.short: Lander and rover that drill for ice. Target 2028.
missions.goal: Study water ice near a permanently shadowed region.
missions.target: Lunar south pole, near a permanently shadowed region

missions.name: Luna-27A
missions.goal: Prospect for water ice and other volatiles; about one year on the surface.

missions.name: Argonaut Mission 1
missions.short: First European cargo lander. Launch by the end of 2030.
missions.goal: Demonstrate Europe's end-to-end delivery of cargo to the south polar region.

missions.name: Blue Moon MK1 Endurance
missions.short: Cargo lander pathfinder near Shackleton crater. Planned 2026, not yet launched.
missions.goal: Pathfinder flight of the MK1 cargo lander, carrying NASA payloads.
missions.target: Lunar south pole, near Shackleton crater

missions.name: Griffin Mission One
missions.goal: Delivers more than 1,100 pounds of cargo, including the FLIP rover.
missions.short: Robotic lander and rover. From January 2027.

missions.name: IM-4 (CP-22)
missions.goal: Six NASA payloads, 79 kg in total, to the south polar region.

past.name: IM-2 Athena
past.short: Landed on Mons Mouton, about 250 m from its target, and tipped over in a small crater. The mission ended early.

past.name: IM-1 Odysseus
past.short: Landed near Malapert A at 80.13°S on a 12° slope and came to rest tilted. About a week of operations.

past.name: Chandrayaan-3
past.short: First landing near the south polar region, at 69.4°S. Lander and rover worked for one lunar day.
